summary: Fastcall factory that builds a multi-block allocator object through the allocator interface embedded in a1. Calls the allocation callback at a1+32 with the allocator context at a1+40 to obtain the header object v6, then allocates an 8 x 1440-byte block array stored at v6[9] and a single a3-byte payload block stored at v6[10] (with v6[11] set to its end address). On success it records a2 at v6[14], zeroes the header word *v6, calls StateResetWithCallback(v6, a1, 0) and returns v6. On any allocation failure it rolls back with the deallocation callback at a1+36 and returns 0.

local_names.a1: allocator interface object (vtable: +32 alloc, +36 free, +40 context)
local_names.a2: token/id stored in the allocator header

operations.description: Call the allocation callback at a1+32 with context *(a1+40), count 1 and size 64 to allocate the allocator header; result is v6.
If v6 is non-null, proceed with setup; otherwise return the unset result (null).
Call the allocation callback at a1+32 with context *(a1+40), count 8 and size 1440 to allocate the block array; store the pointer at v6[9].
If the block array at v6[9] is non-null, continue; otherwise free v6 through the deallocation callback at a1+36 and return 0.
Call the allocation callback at a1+32 with context v8 (a1+40), count 1 and size a3 to allocate the single payload block; store the pointer at v6[10].
If the payload at v6[10] is non-null, finish initialization; otherwise free the block array at v6[9] and the header v6 through the deallocation callback at a1+36 and return 0.
Set v6[11] = a3 + v6[10] (end address of the payload block), v6[14] = a2, and zero the header word *v6.
Call StateResetWithCallback(v6, a1, 0) to initialize the allocator state with the allocator interface as callback owner.
Return v6 as the constructed multi-block allocator object on the success path; the failure paths return 0.
